acceptance_criteria.PL-1: RULED (operator, 2026-08-15): subject resolution is L2-side. The admission worker reads only the L1 manifest's patient_extraction_id via the sanctioned read-only connector, joins it against L2's mirrored identity rows (identity_source set; L1 id preserved verbatim per Phase 2), and resolves-or-mints the intake subject with the existing set-once binding pattern. It never reads L1 patient_extraction identity columns on the run path. Park conditions: unmirrored id, NULL patient_extraction_id, the __L2_INGEST__ synthetic parent, or conflicting identities -> needs-patient-match worklist. Operational precondition: scripts/mirror_l2_identity.py refreshed before/during campaigns; parked docs admit on a later pass after re-mirror.

runs.objective: Eval substrate: synthetic fixture factory and inference stub. Build the shared eval substrate the exit gates depend on: a synthetic fixture factory producing SYN-OR-{01..20}.png, SYN-TXT-{01..05}.txt, a SYN-L1.db builder (document_extraction + patient_extraction with fabricated filenums and NULL-text_path rows), a POC envelope helper, and a deterministic loopback inference stub backend for gate runs (PL-3). No PHI anywhere; everything reproducible from code.

Finalize ADR-A and ADR-B. Promote the two accepted ADR drafts from the handoff package into the docs/architecture ADR series, settling schema, migration, replay, admission-ledger, transactional receipt, and project-scoped identity details, updating only indexes ADR policy requires.

Failure visibility and empty-scope truthfulness. Expose cutover-gate refusals through run status, catch all four top-level boot awaits with a visible failure banner, and render a loud warning for zero execution contexts, per D28 clinician-language error surfaces. Empty-scope evals at this stage use existing doctype scoping (the Import node does not exist yet).

On-card editing and palette policy repair. Remove the delegated/inspector-editing read-only policy, split the CSS selector while keeping Inspect hidden, fix the draft placeholder and drawer dismiss interims, fix palette order, and add the palette-visibility flag hiding vlm/transform/confidence_router while keeping all kinds saveable/executable; merge the Review pill into the process button group per D31.
CSRF coverage for mutating verbs. Extend the fail-closed CSRF rule from POST to PUT and DELETE across route middleware/dependencies with tests, before autosave issues PUTs.

Unified definition-store server migration. Forward-migrate every legacy draft/lock row to named definitions/revisions, prove completeness including get_or_default_pipeline and lock short-circuit cases, then move readiness, save_chain, preview, and execution readers to the unified store.

Unified clients, autosave, run pinning, ordered Test-N. Repoint legacy client calls across the five JS bundles to the unified store, autosave drafts, silently pin a revision on Run, remove user-facing lock ceremony, and implement choose-then-press Test-N against the unified preview path.

Project-scoped definitions and multi-entry graph semantics. Remove run/pipeline document_type keying per ADR-B: uniqueness becomes (project_id, name), doctype moves to import-node config, all three root checks covered, import-fed in-degree relaxed, and all six execution-context call sites updated.

Honest source counts and POC classification. Thread L1 document_type through upstream selection, add the selectable-row count endpoint, expose origin counts, reclassify new POC captures as POC_NOTE, and document/migrate existing routing behavior.

Transactional cutover-receipt regeneration. Make intake registration regenerate the cutover receipt inside the same transaction per ADR-A, with focused concurrency and idempotency tests; precedes every new registration path.

Incremental admission ledger and registration worker. Implement the append-only per-run admission ledger and per-import registration workers per ADR-A: per-document idempotency, prefetch, pause/resume, rerun-from-ledger, actionable needs-match records, PHI-safe failures. Subject resolution per the PL-1 ruling: join the L1 manifest's patient_extraction_id against L2's mirrored identity rows (Phase-2 mirror, identity_source set) and resolve-or-mint the intake subject; never read L1 identity columns on the run path; unmirrored/unlinked/conflicting documents park to the needs-patient-match worklist.

Typed registry and inert source/sink lifecycle. Add mandatory accepts/emits plus declared handles to the node registry, real OCR image/binary inputs, union semantics for Import sources, plain-language incompatibility codes, and explicit no-op execution registration for source/sink kinds.

Editor chrome, pipeline controls, layout grammar. Rewire the footer Save Canvas directly before deleting the toolbar; add pipeline chip, History, Fork; build left/top/right panes with D30 column-scoped top bars; add results-card target and explicit Connect-steps mode with live connectivity feedback; reserve stable mount points for later node packages.

Import-node authoring and source UI. Implement Import-node authoring: empty rail, add/auto-select doctype, circle+rectangle card, ghost sources, L1 multi-select with counts, upload folder/batch UUID persistence, POC Scan/Form gates, preparation strip, and needs-patient-match worklist; endpoints as adapters only.

Process-card behavior, Fields-to-extract strip, edge stubs. Implement process-card expand-on-run/prompt, on-card persistent results with dismiss, freeze-visible running config, the always-present Fields-to-extract strip with D29 neutral/binding styles, per-node schema assignment, arrowheads/input provenance, and typed auto-edge stubs.

Reviewed-write gate and bulk-accept provenance. Enforce reviewed status server-side on the note-review import route with explicit override logging, record accepted_without_individual_review provenance, and provide reviewed/bulk/rejected/unreviewed counts.

Review circle and suggested-review graph behavior. Implement the circular Review node: progress ring, yellow/green non-color-only status, actions, and transient suggested-ghost placement and acceptance semantics.

Shared Review/Try-settings interface. Replace test_parse.js and the test drawer with the shared two-mode Review/Try-settings interface: per-kind renderers, tracked edits, Accept/Reject, same-N rerun, Keep settings, generation/AbortController invalidation, DOM clearing, no storage/console/SSE PHI, and safe-delete supersession/TTL reaper.

Add-to-clinical-database node. Surface the existing pending-sidecar flow as the Add-to-clinical-database node through the hardened import route, with reviewed/bulk/rejected/waiting counts and the verified-at-capture POC exception.

Reviewed Data download. Build the reviewed Data download: remote-client refusal before DB access, no-store, CSRF POST browser download, pre-byte egress witness, reviewed-only SQL, safe basename, PHI warning, and N-of-M metadata.

Saved-view Projection node. Build the Saved-view Projection node: read-only L2 DB connection with SQLite authorizer, parsed-statement allowlist, by-reference (pipeline_ref, field_selector) inputs, preview/download route reusing the egress witness.

Import-region visual-fidelity gate. Author Playwright screenshot specs and reference-crop metadata for the Import region; targeted fixes go back to WP-13-owned CSS/layout per the section-4 fidelity protocol.

Process/review visual-fidelity gate. Author Playwright reference-region checks for process cards, suggested/circular Review, and both shared-interface modes; targeted fixes return to WP-14/16/17 ownership.

Chrome/palette visual-fidelity gate. Author Playwright region checks for chrome: pipeline chip, pane grammar, palettes, Connect-steps, arrowheads, provenance, responsive/focus states; fixes return to WP-12/WP-14.

Export-region visual-fidelity gate. Author Playwright region checks for the export region: right palette, three export card families, PHI/download warnings, partial-review states, Saved-view inputs; fixes return to WP-18/19/20.
Full integration, grumpy path, and release gate. Wire full E2E: EV-E2E-01/02 Playwright specs from fresh databases, CI wiring, PHI scan; fixes go to the owning package rather than accumulating here.
